# The Scent Shelf

> Online perfume shop for India, opening soon. Affordable perfumes from Arabic houses (Lattafa, Afnan, Rasasi, French Avenue, Rayhaan, Armaf, Maison Alhambra, Al Haramain, Khadlaj, Zimaya, Paris Corner, Swiss Arabian, Arabiyat), including ones commonly compared to designer bottles, with planned launch prices in rupees. Designer and niche perfumes are on a separate shelf called Lux. Nothing is on sale yet: customers reserve now and pay at launch.

Scent families, notes and longevity on this site are The Scent Shelf's own estimates. "Smells like" names the designer perfume a bottle is most often compared to; the products are different and the designer brands are not affiliated. Prices are planned launch prices and may change.

## Main pages
- [Shop the shelf](https://ketchup-69.github.io/thescentshelf/shop.html): affordable Arabic perfumes, searchable by note, family and house
- [Lux](https://ketchup-69.github.io/thescentshelf/lux.html): designer and niche perfumes
- [Smells like](https://ketchup-69.github.io/thescentshelf/smells-like/): affordable alternatives to designer perfumes, side by side
- [Scent Finder](https://ketchup-69.github.io/thescentshelf/find.html): a shortlist from a description, notes, budget or a designer perfume you like
- [FAQ](https://ketchup-69.github.io/thescentshelf/faq.html): reserving, buy 5 get 1 free, delivery, refunds
